purpose: Tintable decorative frame behind modular hero artwork; transparent center and outer margin
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent square game asset for DropInn: an empty hand-painted inn-sign portrait frame that will sit BEHIND a separately drawn full-body whimsical hero. Match the coarse, irregular MS Paint mouse-drawn black contours and restrained flat fills of the approved blue hero reference seen in this conversation. Draw ONLY the frame, no hero. Composition: frontal, nearly square inn-sign outline, gently arched upper corners and a slightly uneven horizontal top and bottom, not an oval or circle. Frame occupies approximately 94 percent of the square canvas, with a clear 3 percent transparent outer margin on every side. Narrow ivory/cream painted band about 3 percent of the canvas wide, edged inside and outside with blunt irregular black strokes about 0.7 percent canvas wide. Keep the center completely empty and truly transparent: at least the central 82 percent width and height is open for the hero. Subtle crooked timber-like joins at the two bottom corners, no other ornaments. Loosely drawn actual imperfect shape, a few uneven joins, simple broad fill, no grain or wood texture. Ivory/cream monochrome fill and near-black contours ONLY, intended for runtime color tinting. Absolutely no text, stars, symbols, leaves, bolts, ribbons, pedestal, character, background, shadows, gradients, glow, beveled metal, photorealism, vector-perfect geometry or checkerboard. Entire center and outside background must be alpha transparent. Keep whole frame visible with margin. Output square PNG.

runtimeDerivative.transform: Sharp resize to 256×256 over the complete square source canvas, preserving source placement and alpha; no trimming, crop, center, or paint edits.
runtimeDerivative.review: Inspected actual HeroAvatar browser compositions for all six bodies with no hat, tall Spellbound hat, and wide Shepherd hat, plus default gold and six palette colors, at 256/64/48/24px on pale parchment and dark green. Transparent center and outer margin, intact silhouettes, rear-frame overlaps, and color response visible. Frame remains recognizable at 24px; facial detail is naturally limited. Evidence: output/playwright/inn-frame-review-1.png through inn-frame-review-5.png. This record does not establish saved-hero or hosted behavior.
